headline: What Has The Market Missed In Lululemon Stock's Drop?
summary: Lululemon Athletica (LULU) continues to quietly absorb its own shares, a trend the current stock price appears to ignore. Investors generally view the athletic apparel maker as a leggings brand dealing with stalled sales. The stock lost 41.4% over the past twelve months, while the S&P 500 returned 17.9%. Yet the company steadily reduced its share count alongside that falling valuation, setting up a sharp contradiction. So how much of its own stock is Lululemon buying back.

headline: Raymond James Maintains Outperform on Deckers Outdoor, Lowers Price Target to $105
summary: Raymond James  analyst Rick Patel   maintains Deckers Outdoor (NYSE:DECK) with a Outperform and lowers the price target from $120 to $105.
